evidence: Explicitly targets libbitcoinkernel error reporting needs ('makes error handling in libbitcoinkernel application code difficult') and updates kernel result structures ('src/kernel/result.h', 'src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp').
rationale: Enables library consumers to receive structured error information directly instead of forcing reliance on global AbortNode notification callbacks. Systematically eliminating node-specific AbortNode assumptions is a prerequisite for making validation usable as an independent library.
